verdict.rationale: AMD's own Instinct tooling supports running the GPU in automated, non-interactive environments: a Kubernetes GPU Operator and device plugin, a container toolkit for Docker, the AMD SMI user-space management tool, cluster validation test scripts, and a Slurm-compatible job scheduler. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI pipeline integration or headless automation workflows as such. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, documented headless/non-interactive automation recipes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: GPU Operator Deploy and manage Instinct GPUs in Kubernetes clusters.
AMD Container Toolkit Integrate Instinct GPUs with Docker and container runtimes.
AMD SMI Unified user-space tool to manage and monitor GPUs and drivers.
Cluster Validation Suite Test scripts that validate AMD AI clusters end to end.
Spur AI-native job scheduler, drop-in compatible with Slurm, with GPU-first scheduling and Raft-based state.
